Initial release of gdpr-check — GDPR compliance skill:

- Provides a free 12-item GDPR compliance check based on Regulation (EU) 2016/679.
- Scoring is performed via the CQDev cloud compliance engine; 100 free API calls with a registered key.
- Offers offline item preview mode (`--non-interactive`) with no cloud contact.
- Scored runs require a free API Key and transmit answers securely to compliancehub.cn.
- Outputs a professional compliance report locally.
- Clear agent usage instructions and data handling practices are provided.
